record_type_quote: Instead, here we show transethnic replication of the association of the expanded CTG18.1 trinucleotide repeat polymorphism, which is in the same LD block as rs613872, with FECD in the ethnic Chinese population.

targets.authors: Mootha VV, Gong X, Ku HC, Xing C.
targets.title: Association and familial segregation of CTG18.1 trinucleotide repeat expansion of TCF4 gene in Fuchs' endothelial corneal dystrophy
targets.evidence_quote: Our group replicated the association with 120 FECD cases and 100 controls, finding that one copy of the expanded CTG18.1 allele increased risk of disease by 32.3-fold (95% confidence interval [CI], 13.4-77.6). 27 We found the OR of each copy of the expanded allele estimated to be 66.5 (95% CI: 12.6-350.1) in the Chinese population, mirroring its extremely high OR in Caucasians of 32.3 (95% CI: 13.4-77.6). 27
